component.name: Beast and Crimson
component.summary: Command three tribes in an offline dark-fantasy lane battler

description.p: Beast and Crimson is a deterministic pixel-art lane battler set in a grim dark-fantasy world. Choose one of three rival tribes—each with its own warriors, totem spells, and playstyle—and march across ten keeps to overthrow the Collector King.

ul.li: Three playable tribes (Offense, Defense, and Greed) with 30 unique warriors and abilities
Ten handcrafted campaign stages with biome hazards, plus an Endless survival mode
Warband customization with Mercenary Pacts and Runic Burns that reshape unit stats
Deterministic 60 Hz combat simulation with manual or auto-cast ability control
Fully offline single-player experience with illustrated intro sequence and dynamic soundtrack

screenshot.caption: Battlefield lane combat with deployed warriors and totem spells
Choose your tribe on the title screen
Warband lineup and Runic Burn customization

description.p: Added enemy opening vanguard threat and progressive per-stage pace scaling across Chapters 1–10.
Balance pass across Goldclaw, Bloodfang, and Guardvaw unit costs, cooldowns, and economy, plus itch.io butler helpers.
Apache-2.0 release with Electron desktop wrapper, Flatpak metadata, non-intrusive HUD tooltips, and battle polish.
